purpose: Post-training verification requested by the owner. The model, metrics and provenance are unchanged; nothing was retrained.

duplicates.structure: 35 pairs (70 rows); 60 of the 70 rows have all six bills and all six payments equal to zero (dormant accounts)
duplicates.treatment: Kept and disclosed (different customer IDs; identical dormant profiles are plausible). Nothing removed.

sensitivity.conclusion: Duplicates do not inflate the reported result.

negative_bill_amounts.treatment: Kept. A negative bill is a credit balance (the customer overpaid). Utilisation = max(0, bill) / limit, so a credit balance counts as 0% utilisation; a repayment ratio whose previous bill is <= 0 is set to 1.0 (nothing was owed); repayment ratios are capped at 2.0.

other_preprocessing.excluded_inputs: ID (identifier), SEX, EDUCATION, MARRIAGE (fairness and portability); their undocumented codes therefore have no effect
other_preprocessing.pay_status: used as observed, including codes -2 and 0 that the original paper does not describe
other_preprocessing.features: 14 engineered from age, credit limit, 6 payment statuses, 6 bills and 6 payments (app/ml/credit_risk.features_from_history)
